oracle.scope: Actual encode_chunk and normalize/noise functions extracted from source; CPU values, seeded latent stub; full-model/GPU validation separate.

symbolic_work.domain: Four-frame chunks, F=1 mod 4, contiguous CPU FP32 input. Source-derived element totals; fitted instruction coefficients are observed-state evidence.

limitations: Original CPU page calibration rejected: 26.06% unresolved instruction samples and one conversion page costs 11.36 ns/instruction. Aggregate calibration is only a sensitivity screen.

GX baseline and final inventories match each other, but differ from native by 112 cuDNN launches; prediction misses contribute no kernel service. FA2 input-dependent durations alias under the current signature.
GX replays native GPU controls for the exact three inputs and request order; no GPU numerical correctness claim from GX.
GX uses CPU cache-position compatibility patch. Final native before/after runs restore upstream GPU metadata and change only the input-window patch.
Only the conversion region is explained. Other marked regions remain partly unexplained or underidentified.
Strided windows have only one observed element count; the fitted coefficient is not an established scaling law for arbitrary strides or window sizes.
Reported timings exclude model loading, input decoding/resizing and video-file encoding. Warmup removes one chunk, so 17/33/65 inputs yield 13/29/61 output frames.

full_sync.conclusion: Aligned GX full-sync and partial controls pass. Full-sync is closer to native absolute latency for these inputs, but both modes predict about 0.745 s saved at 65 frames versus native 1.479 s. Synchronization alone does not resolve the timing discrepancy.
full_sync.runtime_integration_correction: Initial failures mixed old binaries with updated GX and omitted the existing private cuDNN/cuBLAS compatibility layer on rebuild; not evidence of an updated-GX regression.

runtime.note: Aligned current CPU timing and GX epoch ABI after two failed attachment attempts; same frozen runtime will run sync and partial controls.
runtime.compatibility_shim: Restored all ten legacy CUDA exports from original successful runtime. Context functions forward to existing v2; unsupported linker/graph/stream functions fail closed if called.

host_dispatch_compatibility.method: Current GX core/epoch runtime, with prior cuDNN/batched-cuBLAS host dispatch, measured context/device attributes and stream-query compatibility. Current preload native-execution boundary is preserved.

runtime.correction: The earlier cuDNN engine failure was caused by omitting the existing private host-dispatch patch during rebuild; it is not established as a current GX regression.

sync_pair.harness_note: Unchanged runner uses its legacy partial_sync role to attach and mark. Actual timing mode is sync in launcher configuration. Its generation_wall_seconds uses virtualized perf_counter during sync; host duration is recorded separately by launcher.

partial_control_pair.harness_note: Unchanged runner uses partial_sync role for late attachment and iteration markers. Actual launcher timing mode is partial_sync. Physical host duration is recorded separately by launcher.
